comment: Generic MDM policy-as-data (fingerprint-free per owner decision 2026-11-11). Per-fingerprint overrides (system-app lists keyed by ro.build.fingerprint, never serial — D10) are added under fingerprints/ ONLY when the post-enrollment capture shows package-ID drift. Applied to the server/phone in Phases D1/D2, gated on DG-3/DG-4 on-device checks.

whitelist_apps.name: FlashScore
whitelist_apps.note: Play ID unresolved from the laptop (store geo-filter, 2026-11-11); read the real package ID off the phone's Play page in D1 before any push

agent_app_settings.name: locked_packages
agent_app_settings.mechanism: agent ConfigUpdater.java:964 -> util/Utils.java lockPackages -> setApplicationHidden (device owner)
agent_app_settings.value_format_warning: comma-separated, NO spaces - agent Utils.java:1170 calls packages.replace() without assigning, so spaces are never stripped
